Most small businesses in Mauritius are invisible on Google Maps, and it costs them customers every day.

Someone in Grand Baie searches for a seafood restaurant. Three places appear on the map. If yours is not one of them, you never had a chance.

The fix is free. A Google Business Profile, set up properly.

Yet I keep seeing unclaimed listings, wrong opening hours, keyword stuffed business names and reviews that never get a reply.

Google is clear on a few things. Your profile only shows once it is verified. Your name must match your real signage. Your primary category affects your local ranking. Offering discounts for reviews is prohibited. And there is no way to pay for a better local ranking.

So it comes down to doing the basics better than the business down the road.

I have written a step by step guide covering setup, verification, categories, photos, posts, reviews, performance insights, the mistakes that get profiles suspended and a simple checklist you can work through this week.
